request.prompt:
Create a completely NEW composition for card U27, 1250 pixels wide ×950 pixels high, landscape25:19. References are mature flat graphic style and bear identity only. Hard edged flat fills, few large solid shapes, 2–3 tones, restrained dark outlines. NO texture, grain, tiny facets, fur strands or 3D modelling.

The attack has ENDED. At the RIGHT EDGE, show only a SMALL strip of the bear's white-grey SIDE OF TORSO and ONE short navy forearm now hanging naturally straight DOWN at its side. The shoulder is mostly outside the frame. The relaxed paw is low at lower-right, short cyan claws naturally pointing DOWN. Do not bend the arm into a raised fist, do not put a fist at the chest, do not fill half the picture with bear shoulder fur. Keep arm-to-torso connection anatomically plausible, hand is not detached. Along only the OUTSIDE of this lowered forearm is a THIN FLAT cold-cyan protective surface newly settled, a narrow fitted strip with its own clear edge, not a second limb, wing, big glowing claw or full armor suit.

At LEFT-CENTRE, show one COMPLETE independent enemy shield, dark iron-grey with clear outer perimeter and side thickness. A dark enemy shoulder and small shield-holding arm behind its left edge establish a real shield, not a wall. Shield has one clear previous claw crack or fresh notch, now subdued and without glowing explosion. The shield tilts away from the bear. Keep a generous clear GAP between shield and lowered bear hand, so no current strike or grip is occurring. One extremely subtle short fading dark-blue recoil curve may lead away from the shield toward the already-lowered arm; it is secondary and never a large swipe or attack beam.

Composition hierarchy: complete struck SHIELD at left-middle plus already LOWERED protected FOREARM on far right, with quiet negative space between them. Grey-purple backdrop and dark simple ground; navy arm, white-grey small flank edge, thin cyan guard plane. The shield's old damage is secondary to calm recovery and protection. No extra limbs, no second hand, no bear head, no chest braid needed because torso is cropped from the side, no giant foreground claw, no particles, no text, numbers, border, icons or UI.

design_override: Root review directed new pose/composition: lowered arm at right edge, complete shield and dark holder shoulder left-middle, avoid B02 repeated raised-arm pose.

plan_card.name: 淬躯爪击
image_review_watchpoints: 从肩到肘、腕、自然弯指必须连续；背侧回臂不得通过180度反腕实现。
薄护面贴合已有手臂外侧但边缘独立，不能生成为第二条长臂或扇形多指。
背景盾伤为从属既成结果；主臂不能仍伸向盾，避免同时画出收回和前击两个相冲动作。
plan_card.prompt:
最高风格优先级：成品卡参考的简洁图形风格优先于身份立绘的材质细节。像精炼的平面海报插画：少数连续硬边大色块，每种材质只有2至3个明暗面。不要笔触、颗粒、细密岩纹、小碎云、软质毛发和密集小切面。角色身份参考只取轮廓与特征，不复制其细碎渲染。保持严肃厚重、非幼态。

卡片：U27《淬躯爪击》。创作一张新的独立插画，核心动词/关系为“覆定”。

镜头与抽象：从身后看回收中的前臂。M0。
画面：一次抓击已经离开敌方暗盾，前臂正收回胸前，手指保持自然弯曲。一层薄而平整的冷青护面沿手臂外侧凝住，原来的爪尖只有短小点色，受击盾的裂痕退到背景。

大形与负形：回收的短弧前臂与贴合外侧的薄护面构成一体，旧攻击结果从属。
色彩：灰紫底、深蓝臂、灰白肩、薄青护面。

25:19横向卡牌插画，只有画面，没有文字、标题、费用、边框或游戏UI。厚而克制的深色轮廓，硬边平涂，2—3个明暗层；少数完整大色块，背景服从唯一主读法。这是有意设计的图形概括，不用软质3D毛发、密集碎毛、体积光和粒子填充。实体角色出现时保持白灰宽肩、深蓝身体、短厚熊吻、青眼与青色短弯爪；只有场景确实露出胸部时才需要胸辫。纯环境或符号图不额外塞熊头、爪子或身份标记。用大形、留白、受力与尺度传达厚重和野性，不能把圆身摆拍、随机拉长的肢体或多余零件当作抽象。

参考用途：身份图用于确认实体角色；C12《厚重皮毛》用于主形清晰度、重量和气质；C08《撕开伤口》用于色块简洁或对象关系。借用这些方法，不复制它们的角色占位、动作轴或独特构图。

明确避免：四枚巨爪呈螺旋桨状；手腕翻转180度；把护甲画成多余肢体；仍在向右挥的大前臂。
图像语义：一次攻击后形成保护，护面必须附着外侧而不是凭空另一只手。
只表现上述单一场面，不增加说明文字、分镜、数值图标或与主动作无关的对象。
